title: Check the size of a directory
summary: Use the `du` command to see how much disk space a specific folder is using. You can choose to see the total size only or a breakdown of subfolders.

aliases.text: how much space does this folder take

steps.explain: Run `du` with the `-sh` flags to show the total size of the directory in human-readable units (like MB or GB) without listing every subfolder.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: The path to the folder you want to measure.

alternatives.explain: To see the size of the directory and all its subdirectories, use `-h` instead of `-sh`.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: The path to the folder you want to measure.

alternatives.explain: To see the size of the directory and all files within it, use `-ah`.
